title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Billing Periods, Renewal Charges and Price Changes
content:
## Membership billing rules — Marlowe & Finch Unlimited

**Rule B1 — First fee.** The first fee is charged when the trial converts, or on the enrollment date when no trial applies, and the membership becomes active. The charge is recorded on the membership ledger as a first charge.

**Rule B2 — Later fees.** Each later fee is charged on the day after the current period ends, at the plan's list fee on that date. The charge is recorded as a renewal, and the new period starts on that day.

**Rule B3 — Price increases.** A list fee increase applies only at a renewal at least 30 days after notice of the increase.

**Rule B4 — Length of a period.** Periods run for the plan's billing period in calendar months. When the start day does not exist in the end month, the period ends on the last day of that month.

**Rule B5 — Renewal notice.** Annual plans send a renewal notice the plan's notice period before renewal. The notice states the fee that will be charged and how to cancel.

**Rule B6 — When a membership renews.** A membership renews only while auto-renew is on and the status is active.

**Rule B7 — Membership fees balance.** The membership fees balance of a membership is the fees charged less the fees refunded.

### Plan figures read by these rules

| Plan | List fee (USD) | Billing period |
|---|---|---|
| Unlimited Standard Monthly | 4.99 | 1 calendar month |
| Unlimited Student Annual | 9.99 | 12 calendar months |
| Unlimited Standard Annual | 24.99 | 12 calendar months |
| Unlimited Express Monthly | 9.99 | 1 calendar month |
| Unlimited Express Annual | 59.00 | 12 calendar months |
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual | 99.00 | 12 calendar months |

### Renewal conditions (Rule B6)

| Auto-renew | Status | Renews |
|---|---|---|
| On | Active | Yes |
| Off | Active | No |
| On | Any status other than active | No |
| Off | Any status other than active | No |

### Worked illustrations (hypothetical dates and amounts)

- *Month-end period.* A monthly period starting on 31 January runs one calendar month; 31 February does not exist, so the period ends on the last day of February.
- *Price increase, notice in time.* Notice of an increase given on 1 March: a renewal on 31 March falls 30 days after notice and is charged at the increased list fee.
- *Price increase, notice too late.* With the same notice, a renewal on 30 March falls 29 days after notice; the increase does not apply at that renewal, which is charged at the list fee before the increase.
- *Balance.* Fees charged of 24.99 and 24.99, with a refund of 24.99, leave a membership fees balance of 24.99.
